reference:
To determine who is younger between Wayne Coyne and Toshiko Koshijima, we compare their birth dates:

- Wayne Coyne was born on January 13, 1961.
- Toshiko Koshijima was born on March 3, 1980.

By comparing these dates, Toshiko Koshijima is younger than Wayne Coyne.

FINDING: Toshiko Koshijima is younger than Wayne Coyne.

[Toshiko Koshijima] Toshiko Koshijima (こしじま としこ , Koshijima Toshiko , born March 3, 1980 in Kanazawa, Ishikawa) is a Japanese singer. Their formal debut came in 2001 with the release of the single "Sakura".
[Wayne Coyne] Wayne Michael Coyne (born January 13, 1961) is an American musician. He is the lead singer, occasional backing vocalist, guitarist, keyboardist, theremin player and songwriter for the band the Flaming Lips.
